title.zh: 自己算算：我们是如何接管 ChatGPT 账户的
title.en: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts

current_state.zh:
安全研究团队 Parameter 披露了一条针对 ChatGPT 的账户接管攻击链，利用了产品的 Preview 内容以及多层前端防御机制。OpenAI 确认两个前端均拦截了报告中所述的消息，已于 10 月 26 日以 P1 级严重性修复该问题，并支付了总额 5000 美元的赏金。

ChatGPT 中被确认的账户接管路径意味着，受害者只需点击一个分享链接，攻击代码就可能在其已登录的会话中执行，从而暴露会话列表和私密内容。不过该攻击链需要用户交互，目前也没有在野利用的报告。

根据研究人员的说法，Preview 沙箱本身并未被突破——在其中渲染的代码无法读取主页面——绕过实际发生在 postMessage、CSP 和 JSONP 等其它环节。所披露的攻击链依赖受害者点击公开的分享链接。
current_state.en:
Security researchers at Parameter disclosed a ChatGPT account-takeover chain that abused the product's Preview content and layered frontend defenses. OpenAI confirmed that both frontends rejected the reported messages, resolved the issue on October 26 as a P1-severity bug, and awarded a total bounty of $5,000.

A confirmed account-takeover path in ChatGPT means a single clicked share link could run code inside a victim's authenticated session, exposing conversation lists and private content. The chain required user interaction and no in-the-wild exploitation has been reported.

According to the researchers' account, the Preview sandbox itself held — code rendered there could not read the main page — and the bypass instead worked through other layers such as postMessage, CSP and JSONP gadgets. The disclosed chain depended on the victim clicking a public share link.

updates.background_zh: ChatGPT 的 Preview 功能会把 HTML 代码块渲染成一个可运行的小网页，并在独立源的受限框架中运行。OpenAI 自 2023 年起运行漏洞赏金计划，奖励向其报告系统漏洞的研究人员。
updates.background_en: ChatGPT's Preview feature turns an HTML code block into a small working webpage, which the product runs inside a restricted frame on a separate web origin. OpenAI has run a bug bounty program since 2023 to reward researchers who report vulnerabilities in its systems.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的评论者认为这篇技术文章难以理解，有人指出 JSONP 部分讲的是该机制如何运作，而不是他们如何绕过它。多位评论者认为 5000 美元的赏金过低，可能打击后续报告漏洞的积极性；还有人贴出了另一份报告，称 ChatGPT 桌面版中启动过“Work”对话的电脑存在远程访问文件系统的可能。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters found the writeup hard to follow, with one noting the JSONP section explained how the mechanism works rather than how it was bypassed. Several argued the $5,000 payout is too low and could discourage future reports, and one commenter linked a separate report of remote file-system access via 'Work' chats in the ChatGPT desktop app.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事对加密市场没有直接传导路径，影响主要限于 AI 概念代币的市场情绪——AI 平台反复出现的高关注度安全披露可能对该板块叙事形成压力。本次披露不涉及任何交易平台、托管安排或链上机制。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct transmission to crypto markets; the read-across is limited to sentiment around AI-themed tokens, where recurring high-profile AI platform security disclosures can weigh on the sector narrative. No trading venue, custody arrangement or on-chain mechanism is implicated by this disclosure.
